content.text:
Yes, this is really common at 20 months. Sudden night wakings often come with a growth spurt, teething, or a nap and bedtime that no longer fit.

Tonight, keep the 2am visit short and boring. Go in, keep the lights low, say one calm line like "night night, I'm here," and leave while they're still drowsy. Skip the feeds, the play and the screens, so 2am doesn't turn into a fun time.

If they seem unwell or in pain, call Health811 at 811 any time, or 911 in an emergency.
